outcome: Inviting a list of people reports what happened to each address.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every address on the list is invited.

expected_verification.assertion: both addresses on a two-address list are sent an invite

acceptance_criteria.text: An address that fails is reported as failed and does not stop the rest of the list.

expected_verification.assertion: a list whose first address fails still invites the second and returns a failed result for the first
